geopolitics_summary: US diesel export ban threat and G7 reserve release negotiations dominate; Middle East conflict props crude; EU fiscal rule relaxation pressure from energy costs.

themes.headline: Trump threatens US diesel export ban; G7 negotiates reserve releases
themes.why_it_matters: US diesel export ban would tighten NW European refined product supply; upward pressure on heating fuel costs, gas-to-power switching, and demand destruction risk. Reserve releases aim to mitigate but create volatility. Direct impact on European fuel bills and power demand.

themes.headline: G7 agrees oil and diesel reserve release after US pressure
themes.why_it_matters: Large coordinated reserve releases (100M barrels crude + diesel) ease global refined product tightness, reducing European heating fuel costs and demand for gas-fired generation. Lower heating margin improves power merit-order stack.

themes.headline: Middle East conflict pushes crude and refinery margins higher in Q3 2026
themes.why_it_matters: Rising crude and refinery margins increase European heating fuel costs, amplifying demand for gas-fired generation and lifting power prices via gas-to-power spread and merit-order effect. Indirect TTF pressure via heating demand.

themes.headline: US natural gas production hits record high in July 2026
themes.why_it_matters: Record US LNG production capacity potentially increases global LNG supply and weakens TTF vs. Henry Hub spreads. Lower arbitrage incentive eases European gas tightness; bearish for TTF and downstream power. Monitor LNG export terminal utilization.

themes.headline: EU countries seek fiscal rule relaxation amid persistent energy cost pressures
themes.why_it_matters: Italy and others pushing to loosen overspending caps to fund energy support schemes. Policy uncertainty on state aid, capacity support, and price controls affects long-term power/gas investment signals and storage dynamics.

watchlist: US diesel export ban decision timeline and extent of any carve-outs for allies.
Timing and magnitude of announced G7 / European reserve releases (crude, diesel, strategic stocks).
LNG export facility utilization data; watch for capacity increases feeding TTF arb.
EU fiscal rule review vote / outcome; implications for energy support budgets and capacity mechanisms.
